summary: Official warnings note that people taking Pramipexole Dihydrochloride might fall asleep suddenly without any warning during their daily activities, may experience an urge to act on compulsive or hard-to-control behaviors, and can develop low blood pressure when standing up, known as orthostatic hypotension [3]. Additionally, results from a small computer model, rather than tests conducted in people, estimated a medium risk score of 51 for the liver and a low risk score of 25 for the heart [M]. Overall, the drug has been involved in 14 clinical trials, though some were stopped early due to sponsor funding withdrawal or slow patient enrollment [4][5][7].
